description: Arena Saves. Pause & save. WHEN: park a single-player or vs-house match and come back later. op:list shows your save blocks + open matches; op:save {match_id, label} closes the match into a block (no live slot held); op:resume {save_id} brings it back with the SAME match_id and tick; op:drop {save_id} frees a block. 10 blocks free. Not for tournaments or live matches against an outside bot. Saves ride your key's 30-day clock. Example: arena_saves {}

label.description: Optional name for the save (max 80 chars).

match_id.description: For op:save - the active match to park.

name: arena_saves
title: Arena Saves
